_comment: OS Agent memory tuning config. Change value fields to tune runtime behavior.

default_confidence.desc: Default confidence for new Core facts.

default_importance.desc: Default importance for new Core facts.

confidence_boost.desc: Confidence increment when the same fact appears again.

search_relative_cutoff.desc: Drop Core hits scoring below this fraction of the top hit. 0 disables.

semantic_min_similarity.desc: Absolute cosine floor for semantic Core hits.

semantic_relative_cutoff.desc: Drop semantic hits below this fraction of the best similarity. 0 disables.

recency_window_days.desc: Core recency scoring window in days.

recency_floor.desc: Minimum recency factor for old Core facts.

composite_keyword_weight.desc: Core composite score weight for keyword hits.

composite_confidence_weight.desc: Core composite score weight for confidence.

composite_importance_weight.desc: Core composite score weight for importance.

composite_recency_weight.desc: Core composite score weight for recency.

search_facts_top_k.desc: Default archived fact search result limit.

search_raw_events_top_k.desc: Default raw event fallback search result limit.

recency_window_days.desc: Archival recency scoring window in days.

recency_floor.desc: Minimum recency factor for archived facts.

composite_keyword_weight.desc: Archival composite score weight for keyword hits.

composite_recency_weight.desc: Archival composite score weight for recency.

raw_event_hot_max_events.desc: Maximum raw events kept in the hot JSONL window before gzip archival.

raw_event_archive_enabled.desc: Move evicted raw events to a compressed cold archive.

global_summary_max_chars.desc: Maximum extractive summary size across sessions.

global_summary_max_sessions.desc: Maximum sessions represented in the global summary.

min_core_results.desc: Fallback to Archival when Core hits are below this count.

max_total.desc: Maximum facts returned by Core + Archival + raw fallback.

raw_event_default_confidence.desc: Confidence assigned to raw-event fallback pseudo facts.

raw_event_default_importance.desc: Importance assigned to raw-event fallback pseudo facts.

include_legacy_markdown_context.desc: Include legacy Markdown retrieval in AgentLoop context alongside Mem0 recall.

session_dedup.desc: Within one session, keep only the latest fact for each entity+attribute before merging.

confidence_threshold_legacy_write.desc: Minimum confidence required before backfilling legacy Markdown memory.

backfill_legacy_markdown.desc: Maintain Markdown as a readable mirror of active Core facts.

skip_memory_file_facts.desc: Do not extract project facts from memory metadata files.

per_file_attributes.desc: Use per-file attributes such as file_content:README.md to avoid cross-file overwrites.

confidence_boost.desc: Confidence increment when pipeline sees an unchanged fact.

archive_raw_events.desc: Persist complete session events for deep recall fallback.

behavior_enabled.desc: Aggregate repeated non-sensitive tool parameters into preferences.

behavior_min_observations.desc: Repeated observations required before inferring a behavior preference.

session_preference_consolidation_enabled.desc: Keep one low-confidence implicit preference observation per session.

session_preference_confidence.desc: Confidence assigned to implicit session preference observations.

session_preference_importance.desc: Importance assigned to implicit session preference observations.

preference_reinforcement_enabled.desc: Promote matching observations from independent sessions.

preference_reinforcement_min_sessions.desc: Independent sessions required before preference promotion.

preference_reinforcement_similarity.desc: Minimum lexical overlap for observation reinforcement.

preference_reinforcement_confidence.desc: Initial confidence for a reinforced preference.

enabled.desc: Use conservative query planning before Mem0 recall.

distillation_candidate_limit.desc: Recall candidates collected before policy distillation.

trace_enabled.desc: Append agentic memory action traces for later training.

trace_file.desc: Trace file path relative to the memory root.
